sources.title: Qwen3 235B A22B Thinking 2507 - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3 235B A22B Thinking 2507 is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model specifically designed for extended reasoning tasks. With 235 billion total parameters and 22 billion activated parameters per token, this model represents Alibaba's approach to transparent reasoning processes in large language models.
